title: Schema A: trace, paths and tour
description: What happens, in order: the components a request calls, the paths it takes through them, and a tour whose prose links back to them. Read by style 1, the linked-text tour. Rust type: rain_lab::schema::trace::Trace.

entities.description: Every component, function, table and data object the paths name.

paths.description: Each request path, in the order the tour should meet them.

tour.description: The tour's steps, read in order.

id.description: Unique among the entities; steps, tour text and focus lists name it.

layer.description: Where it runs: web or ui (frontend), api or domain (backend), data or db (database); anything else is drawn as Other.

parent.description: The entity it sits inside, such as a component's page; the map draws it inside the parent's box.

fields.description: For a data object: the fields worth naming when a call carries it.

id.description: Unique among the paths; tour text links to it with [[id]].

name.description: What the path does, as its line's name.

steps.description: The calls the path makes, in calling order.

call.description: What the call says, such as RecordVoucher(id, amount).

carries.description: Ids of the data objects travelling with the call; the packet is labelled with them.

fragment.description: The call runs conditionally (alt, opt) or repeatedly (loop); tagged on its stretch.

text.description: One or two sentences; [[id]] links an entity or a path.

focus.description: Entity ids the camera frames and lights while the step plays.

camera.description: Limits on the camera for this step.

zoom.description: The most the camera zooms in while framing the step's focus (1 is the whole map).

Status.description: What the change did to the call.
